My name is Konstantinos Gkanas and this is my portfolio for STA 9750. I am a current MSBA grad student at the Zicklin School of Business here at Baruch College and this is my second semester. Prior to starting my graduate degree here, I graduated from The City College of New York with a degree in History and Economics. I LOVE football (or soccer as we like to call it here in the US) and I love collecting fragrances. Welcome!



```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

if(!require("leaflet")){
    options(repos=c(CRAN="https://cloud.r-project.org"))
    install.packages("leaflet")
    stopifnot(require("leaflet"))
}

baruch_longitude <- -73.98333
baruch_latitude  <- +40.74028

leaflet() |>
  addTiles() |>
  setView(baruch_longitude, baruch_latitude, zoom=17) |>
  addPopups(baruch_longitude, baruch_latitude, 
            "I am a Master's student at <b>Baruch College</b>!")
```
